title: Complete Sports & Management India IPO Details
intro:
Complete Sports and Management IPO is a book build issue of ₹74.93 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 55.50 lakh shares of ₹74.93 crore.

Complete Sports and Management IPO bidding opened for subscription on Aug 28, 2026 and will close on Sep 1, 2026. The allotment for the Complete Sports and Management IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 2, 2026. Complete Sports and Management IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 4, 2026.

Complete Sports and Management IPO is set issue price band at ₹128 to ₹135 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,70,000 (2,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,000 shares), amounting to ₹4,05,000.

Smart Horizon Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Shreni Shares Ltd.

Refer to Complete Sports and Management IPO RHP for detailed Information.

about.text:
Incorporated in 2002, Complete Sports and Management India Limited is engaged in the business of sourcing, trading and distribution of a diversified portfolio of amusement and leisure equipment, along with providing installation, commissioning, maintenance and related consulting services. The company operate across the amusement, entertainment and leisure infrastructure value chain and provide end-to-end solutions to customers for the development and operation of entertainment destinations.

The company has established an operational presence in both India and Singapore, enabling us to effectively serve domestic as well as international markets.

As of July 31, 2026, the company had 136 employees.

objectives: 1 — Funding the capital expenditure requirements of the Company towards the purchase of gaming equipment and other capital equipment, including computers, printers and software, equipment and tools, and CCTV and safety equipment, for its existing warehouse located at Bhiwandi, Maharashtra.
2 — Funding the capital expenditure requirements of the Company towards the setting up of the 'Duckpin – The Bowling Bistro' entertainment centre in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
3 — Repayment and/or prepayment, in full or in part, of certain outstanding borrowings availed by the Company from banks and financial institutions

faqs.answer: Complete Sports and Management IPO is a SME IPO of 55,50,000 equity shares of the face value of ₹ 10 aggregating up to ₹ 75 Crores. The issue is priced at ₹128 to ₹135 . The minimum order quantity is 1000 . The IPO opens on Fri, Aug 28, 2026 , and closes on Tue, Sep 1, 2026 . Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar for the IPO . The shares are proposed to be listed on BSE SME .

faqs.question: How to apply in Complete Sports and Management IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Complete Sports and Management IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Complete Sports and Management IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Complete Sports and Management IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Complete Sports and Management IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Complete Sports and Management IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Complete Sports and Management IPO opens on Fri, Aug 28, 2026 and closes on Tue, Sep 1, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Complete Sports and Management IPO?
faqs.answer: Complete Sports and Management IPO lot size is 1000 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,70,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Complete Sports and Management IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Complete Sports and Management IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Complete Sports and Management IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Complete Sports and Management IPO will be done on Wednesday, September 2, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Sep 3, 2026 . Check the Complete Sports and Management IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Complete Sports and Management IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Complete Sports and Management IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Fri, Sep 4, 2026 .
